text: After her father's death, teenager Leah Reyes is uprooted to a remote house in the woods. In a fit of anger she [performs an occult ritual to summon the demon Pyewacket|origin|deliberately called up] to kill her mother, then regrets it as the two grow close again. Noises stir in the attic and dirt piles on the floors, and a paranormalist warns that the demon is a shape-shifter that may [wear her mother's face|rules|it wears a familiar face], [the only cure a reversal of the ritual in the forest|rules|it can be undone].
